intro: I bring enthusiasm to every class. Alongside the “what” and “how” of analytics, I ask why a method matters, what its results mean, and who should care.

courses.label: BNAL 432 / 532 · 2026
courses.title: Predictive Analytics for Business
courses.description: Forecasting and predictive modeling in R, with an emphasis on choosing methods, evaluating predictions, and applying them to business decisions.

courses.label: BNAL 407 / 507 · 2025–2026
courses.title: Prescriptive Analytics of Management Science
courses.description: Formulating and solving optimization models in Excel, interpreting trade-offs, and understanding their uses and limitations in business decisions.

courses.label: BNAL 206 · 2025
courses.title: Business Analytics I
courses.description: Descriptive statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, and decision-making under uncertainty, using Excel and business applications.
